title: liketrek/TREK
claim: liketrek/TREK — A self-hosted travel/trip planner with real-time collaboration, maps, budgets, packing lists, PWA and SSO.
hook: TripIt + Wanderlog + Splitwise in one self-hosted app — and an AI can run it for you through 150+ MCP tools.
why_good: Plan trips on a drag-and-drop day planner with interactive maps (Leaflet/Mapbox, routes, 3D) and place import from Google/Naver Maps lists and GPX/KML; auto-pull flights and hotels from booking-confirmation emails and PDFs; split costs Splitwise-style (multi-currency, settle-up); packing lists, 16-day weather, PDF export; real-time multi-user editing with SSO, passkeys and group chat.
value: Buyer: self-hosters and small travel clubs/agencies who want a branded, private Wanderlog. Money: a hosted edition + team seats. But it fights consumer-travel distribution, so the realistic play is a beloved self-host tool with an optional hosted tier, not a venture rocket.
risk: Why not a pick: consumer travel is a distribution graveyard and self-hosted planners stay niche — the product is excellent, the business is hard. Watch whether the MCP/AI-agent angle pulls a distinct audience; that's the one thing here that isn't already crowded.

zh.claim: liketrek/TREK —— 自托管的旅行/行程规划器,支持实时协作、地图、预算、打包清单、PWA 与 SSO。
zh.hook: TripIt + Wanderlog + Splitwise 合体的自托管 app——还能让 AI 通过 150+ 个 MCP 工具替你操作。
zh.why_good: 在拖拽式日程板上规划行程,配交互地图(Leaflet/Mapbox、路线、3D),从 Google/Naver Maps 清单和 GPX/KML 导入地点;自动从订票确认邮件和 PDF 抓取机票/酒店;Splitwise 式分账(多币种、结算);打包清单、16 天天气、导出 PDF;多人实时协作,带 SSO、passkey 和群聊。
zh.value: 买家:想要带品牌、私有 Wanderlog 的自托管玩家和小型旅行俱乐部/机构。变现:托管版 + 团队席位。但它要面对消费级旅行的获客难题,现实打法是『受欢迎的自托管工具 + 可选托管档』,不是能起飞的风投项目。
zh.risk: 为什么没进精选:消费级旅行是获客坟场,自托管规划器天然小众——产品很棒,但生意难做。看点:MCP/AI-agent 这个角度能否拉来一批不同的用户;这是它唯一还没被挤爆的地方。
zh.does: 在拖拽式日程板上规划行程,配交互地图(Leaflet/Mapbox、路线、3D),从 Google/Naver Maps 清单和 GPX/KML 导入地点;自动从订票确认邮件和 PDF 抓取机票/酒店;Splitwise 式分账(多币种、结算);打包清单、16 天天气、导出 PDF;多人实时协作,带 SSO、passkey 和群聊。
zh.edge: 它基本是 TripIt + Wanderlog + Splitwise 合体、且可自托管——还内置 MCP server(OAuth 2.1、150+ 工具),AI 助手能端到端替你建行程、排每日计划、生成打包清单、管预算。
zh.why_use: 一条 Docker 命令、数据在自己机器、不用交按人头的旅行 SaaS 费,一次替掉三个付费 app;MCP 那层让它成为极少数『AI agent 能完整操作』的消费级应用。

does: Plan trips on a drag-and-drop day planner with interactive maps (Leaflet/Mapbox, routes, 3D) and place import from Google/Naver Maps lists and GPX/KML; auto-pull flights and hotels from booking-confirmation emails and PDFs; split costs Splitwise-style (multi-currency, settle-up); packing lists, 16-day weather, PDF export; real-time multi-user editing with SSO, passkeys and group chat.
edge: It's basically TripIt + Wanderlog + Splitwise fused into one self-hosted app — and it ships a built-in MCP server (OAuth 2.1, 150+ tools) so an AI assistant can create trips, plan days, build packing lists and manage budgets end to end.
why_use: One Docker command, your data on your own box, no per-seat travel-SaaS bill, and it replaces three paid apps at once; the MCP layer makes it one of the very few consumer apps an AI agent can fully operate.
